name: Kyle Newacheck
biography: Kyle Newacheck (born January 23, 1984) is an American television writer, director, producer and actor. He is one of the creators of the Comedy Central show Workaholics, in which he also co-starred. He is a producer and director on the FX comedy horror series What We Do in the Shadows. Newacheck is also a professional pickleball player signed to the Selkirk Emerging Pros team.
